answer: Require every privileged action to solve a fresh puzzle bound to the agent's identity and the latest on-chain state, with difficulty rising as privileges grow, so a sybil farm cannot batch cheap actions across clones; the cost climbs like a vine strangling each new shoot. The failure mode is rented compute farms, so the check verifies each solution references the current epoch secret and rejects any batch whose solve times cluster faster than an honest velvet-smooth pace allows, letting only genuinely paced work drift through like a zephyr.
